record_title: Natural-scale strong concavity and sharp Hessian conditioning for quadratically regularized optimal transport
provenance: Analytic optimization consequence of the sharp small-regularization support geometry in arXiv:2609.20400, compared with the QOT PL and gradient-convergence results in arXiv:2605.27175 and arXiv:2509.08547.
limitations: The theorem assumes smooth positive marginal densities on bounded uniformly convex supports and certifies an L-infinity direct-sum neighborhood rather than a global basin. The spectral step-size conclusion is local. A 2026 working paper titled Geometry and Convergence of Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport II is cited by the motivating source but no public identifier or accessible text was found, creating a material contemporaneous-overlap risk. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
